title: Recover an unknown collating order from physically fixed entry sequences
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: alphabetized entries under an order-preserving character code impose exact pairwise alphabet inequalities. Solve the inverse collating-order problem by a precedence DAG and predict held entry ordering without guessing Latin values.

design.mechanism: One fixed total order on literal symbols makes every predeclared physical entry list lexicographically nondecreasing. Compare each neighboring pair at its first unequal character; impose a directed precedence edge. A longer string preceding its own proper prefix is an immediate contradiction under standard short-before-extension order.
design.unit: Complete definite raw entry groups in independently fixed physical order, with exact spaces retained. Initial concrete source anchor is the published f88r three-row 6+6+4 label inventory. Each row is a separate candidate list; no circular reorigining, row permutation, root stripping or target-selected exceptions. Which documented reading direction applies must be frozen before accessing labels.
design.source_anchor: experiments/yolo/sidequest_semantic_f88r_six_six_four_label_alignment_nine_hundred_eighty_eighth/PASS988_REPORT.md establishes sixteen local labels and three rows, while explicitly not identifying species. Alphita is an independent example of alphabetized medical headword organization, not evidence that f88r copies it.
design.prediction: The union of all observed first-difference inequalities is acyclic and held neighboring entries respect every already forced comparison. All words sharing an exact prefix occupy a contiguous interval within each fully sorted list.
design.falsifier: A directed cycle or a proper-prefix inversion refutes the declared sorted-list model. A surviving DAG reconstructs only a partial collating order. If every held comparison remains unconstrained, the model has supplied no predictive reconstruction.
design.smallest_test: A one-hour preregistered pass on existing admitted fixed rows can emit a short cycle certificate or the exact partial order and held comparisons. No cipher search or plaintext corpus is necessary. No target labels were opened for this proposal.
design.nearest_predecessors: IL016 tested correspondence to externally named herbal witness order; GDT794 tested repeated complete-label geometric or ordinal positions. This proposal instead asks whether any shared symbol collation explains internal physical list ordering and recovers necessary inequalities. Bounded registry alphabetical/lexicographic searches found no identical design.
design.scope_note: RAW_UNSCREENED, unreviewed. Applies only to sorted encoded spellings or an order-preserving character encoding of sorted plaintext names; it is not a general cipher test. Reordered copies, homophonic spelling, abbreviated words and other sorting conventions are outside the declared class. A surviving symbol order is neither a phonetic key nor a meaning assignment. No new image or target query is authorized by intake.
